body:
Tonight's joint install sequence (Fable2 #7380, agreed with Engram::Fable #8676), keeping the freeze to minutes:
(0) Both release builds run serially on Central: Engram 5bcd10b8 (Merger), then TermAl `cargo build --release --bin termal` from the master checkout at 487cb4e4, in the SEPARATE target dir target/install-target (memories termal-install-procedure-atomic and install-build-separate-target-then-swap-2026-11-19), so the live exe never disappears. Tell Fable2 when TermAl's binary is BUILT, with its build hash read from the build, never hashed by hand.
(1) Engram::Fable announces the write freeze. Opus2 relays it verbatim to every TermAl coder and runner (no termal_evaluate_acceptance, no registered launcher runs, no done/gate) and confirms nothing registered is in flight.
(2) Merger installs engram.exe (records build_fingerprint); Engram::Fable tells Fable2 "Engram installed".
(3) Opus2 installs TermAl at target/release/termal.exe in the master checkout: rename the running exe aside as termal.exe.<sha8>.bak, copy the new one in from the same volume, and record it on w-b646.
(4) Fable2 sends Greg "restart now" with the build hash and the reason.
After the restart: Legal JOB1/JOB2, 5A44-WIN, 7E4F R3 Windows diag, w-f3ee a263e847, c4c0 live check w-e5430c654802, Wave A.
